content.short: Alpha Quark is a SocialFi platform for tokenizing IP rights and providing NFT-collateralized lending services.
content.description:
Alpha Quark is a pioneering decentralized ecosystem designed to bridge the gap between traditional intellectual property (IP) and the digital economy. The platform specializes in the tokenization of high-value IP rights—including music royalties, film copyrights, and webtoons—allowing creators to monetize their work directly through fractionalized digital tokens. Alpha Quark also features a professional-grade NFT lending marketplace where holders can use their digital collectibles as collateral to obtain instant liquidity in stablecoins without selling their assets.

Operating across major blockchain networks like BNB Chain and Klaytn, the protocol provides a robust and transparent framework for SocialFi and credit management. The platform focuses on user sovereignty and regulatory alignment, ensuring that all IP-backed tokens are verified by professional oracles. Through its commitment to technological innovation and creator empowerment, Alpha Quark is building the essential infrastructure for a more equitable virtual world, where digital ownership is a core utility and creative effort is recognized as a globally accessible asset.
content.meta: Alpha Quark offers IP rights tokenization and NFT-collateralized lending for the global creator economy.
